about: Lesson 12 (Cheap or clean?): six hand-made plans for Prairie Town, each run for a year by lesson 13's model (seven representative weeks of 2025, EIA and NREL costs, default scenario). 'result' is precomputed with that model; _tests/learn/test_12-trade-offs.js re-solves each plan and checks every number the page states. Plans are illustrative choices, not recommendations.
